# agent-task-queue

> In-memory priority task queue for agent workers in Go: leases with tokens, retries with capped exponential backoff, a bounded dead list and an injected clock. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u226-agent-task-queue`, package `agenttaskqueue`, MIT licensed, Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API, errors and limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): package shape, concurrency and ordering
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): commands and test coverage defined by the specification
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope and out-of-scope
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded

## Notes

- Public API: `New`, `Enqueue`, `Lease`, `Ack`, `Nack`, `Dead`, `Stats`.
- Error codes: `invalid_task`, `duplicate`, `queue_full`, `payload_too_large`, `not_found`, `stale_lease`, `invalid_options`.
